purpose: Offline frame replay (tools/frame_replay.md): one gi_hit_direct replay pack at S8 (static view), taken inside a 15 s rt_stats window so the live 'GI hit direct' / 'hit material' lines of the same frames are the replay's reference. Needs a layer + core build with the replay_pack writer (layer/replay.cpp, ABI 25) and its texture read (shaders/replay_image.hlsl). Texture budget (rp::fill_budget) under replay_pack_cap_mb=3300 (one-off, user-approved: pack about 976 + 2054 MB = 3.03 GB): the table images and both VT cache images (s1b3+b14 2/2, the 2054 MB hit cache included) must be kept. Post step (post_replay.ps1): replays the new pack offline and, only when its hit material qualified > 0 and sampling <= the live rate, deletes the older captures/replay-* packs (the newest is kept). The pack also carries the deferred lighting inputs (sets 2-3: G-buffer albedo/material, AO, sky irradiance and specular cubes, DFG LUT, probe records and the cubes they name, atmosphere constants, transmittance LUT, clouds; tools/frame_replay.md "Lighting inputs"): the post step also runs frame_replay --native-ambient (native ambient vs the PT far field) and prints its deciding lines.
